definitions.gloss: rest area; rest stop; rest station
definitions.explanation: A designated place for resting, commonly found along highways, in parks, or at tourist spots.

examples.japanese: ⟦{高速道路|こうそくどうろ}→高速道路：09242_kousokudouro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{休憩所|きゅうけいじょ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{休|やす}んだ→休む：00606_yasumu⟧。
examples.english: I rested at a rest area on the highway.

examples.japanese: ⟦{登山|とざん}→登山：03457_tozan⟧⟦コース→コース：10864_koosu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{休憩所|きゅうけいじょ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There's a rest area on the hiking trail.

examples.japanese: {休憩所|きゅうけいじょ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{飲|の}み{物|もの}→飲み物：02929_nomimono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought a drink at the rest area.

notes:
FORMS:
⟦{休憩|きゅうけい}→休憩：00262_kyuukei⟧ (rest, break) + ⟦{所|じょ}→〜所：09844_sho⟧ (place; read じょ here through rendaku)

TYPES:
- ⟦{高速道路|こうそくどうろ}→高速道路：09242_kousokudouro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{休憩所|きゅうけいじょ} - highway rest area
  - SA = ⟦サービスエリア→サービスエリア：11333_saabisueria⟧ (service area; larger, with more facilities)
  - PA = ⟦パーキングエリア→パーキングエリア：25068_paakingueria⟧ (parking area; smaller)
- ⟦{観光地|かんこうち}→観光地：14163_kankouchi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{休憩所|きゅうけいじょ} - tourist spot rest area
- ⟦{登山|とざん}→登山：03457_tozan⟧{休憩所|きゅうけいじょ} - mountain hiking rest station

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {休憩所|きゅうけいじょ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{休|やす}む→休む：00606_yasumu⟧ - to rest at a rest area
- {休憩所|きゅうけいじょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{寄|よ}る→寄る：02440_yoru⟧ - to stop by a rest area

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{休憩室|きゅうけいしつ}→休憩室：23410_kyuukeishitsu⟧ - break room (indoors, in an office or workplace)
- ⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧ - roadside station (on ordinary roads, with local produce and food stalls)
